title: Power and precision planning for standard study designs
summary: A typed dispatcher for the standard analytic power, precision and model-floor calculations used by Ask Mallard plans. Rule-based outputs are labelled floors and never reported as power.
pinned_defaults: Means use the exact two-sided noncentral t distribution; the normal approximation is used only to start the integer search.
Two-proportion planning uses a pooled null variance and unpooled alternative variance; noninferiority uses a one-sided alpha and unpooled assumed rates.
Diagnostic accuracy, kappa and a single proportion are precision calculations, not hypothesis-test power.
Events-per-variable and subjects-per-variable are labelled rule-of-thumb floors. They do not set a final target when an effect- or precision-based requirement is available.
No attrition or missing-data inflation is applied inside these functions; it is a separate, visible plan assumption.
